description: Prefixes of the environment variables dropped from every script test prepush runs. A push the post-commit hook starts leaks GIT_INDEX_FILE=.git/index (and the commit's GIT_AUTHOR_*) into the hooks, which would point a test's git at the checkout's own index; OU_GATE_* are the gate's own variables, which a test never inherits there either. The forge credentials (Origin, GitHub) and the control plane token are among them: a script test never reaches a real forge.
